proposals.evidence: DEDR1184 explicitly gives Tamil kaṇṇi rope/neckrope, Kannada kaṇṇi rope/cord and Kota kayṇ yokerope. These simple southern survey kaṇṇi/kanni and Irula kəinni rope responses match the documented rope noun, with retroflex/gemination/vowel spelling retained; no eye-word parent is substituted. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

These simple survey vala-/bala- forms preserve the strong/right family and source adjectival endings. Parji velā is the right-side stem without hand; correctness-sense sariyāna responses and longer compounds are excluded.
